preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of cities n must be between 1 and 40000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each total duration of concerts b_i must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and len(a) == n and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a))
postconditions.description: If no suitable sequence a exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the sequence a of n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a[(i + j) % n] * (j + 1) for j in range(n)) == b[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The total duration of concerts in each town must match the given b_i values.
